The next meeting date was left to an email poll.

what_happened.line: The committee discussed having no town site for a new studio and said it cannot afford to own and run a building, preferring to lease from the town.
Members said the operations budget comes from the Comcast franchise fee and must stay within that annual income; a chart showed revenue fairly constant lately.
The committee moved to appoint Steve as clerk, but the minutes could not make out the vote.
The prior minutes were approved on a motion and second, and the vote in favor appears to have carried.
The chair will email members for availability in the first two weeks of July; the next meeting must reappoint officers, including who chairs.

why_it_matters: Cable access programming is paid from a franchise fee on cable bills, and members raised possible declines from cord cutting and a proposed law on streaming fees.
The committee has been saving for a studio's contents, not its building, so a studio depends on the town providing space, which a later town meeting would be asked to fund.
